descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii de inginerie, Dezvoltare de software și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Grafton is looking for Software Engineers to join a team developing innovative software solutions in the fields of Artificial Intelligence and Cybersecurity.
 The company is currently working on multiple research and development projects, focused on building secure digital platforms, AI-powered applications, and cybersecurity solutions.
 We are hiring for three development areas: 
 * Software Development – designing, developing, and maintaining software applications, backend components, APIs, and system integrations.
 * Full Stack Development – developing end-to-end software solutions, covering both frontend and backend functionalities.
 * Software & AI Development – building software applications and integrating AI technologies, models, and intelligent functionalities.
 The specific role and project will be discussed during the recruitment process, based on each candidate’s technical background, experience, and interests.
 Key Responsibilities
 * Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications and components.
 * Contribute to the development of secure, scalable, and reliable software solutions.
 * Work with modern development technologies, frameworks, and tools.
 * Collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
 * Participate in technical problem-solving, system improvements, and research & development activities.
 * Ensure code quality, security, and efficient software delivery.
 Requirements
 * Minimum 3 years of experience in software development.
 * Strong programming skills and experience developing software applications.
 * Experience with modern development environments and technologies such as Python, FastAPI, Django, Docker, Linux, Git, Cloud, or microservices.
 * Good understanding of software architecture, APIs, databases, and system integrations.
 * Experience with frontend technologies and/or AI development is an advantage, depending on the role.
 * Understanding of software development best practices, with a focus on code quality and security.
 * Analytical thinking, adaptability, and a proactive, problem-solving mindset.
 What We Offer
 * The opportunity to contribute to innovative R&D projects in AI and Cybersecurity.
 * Exposure to modern technologies and technically challenging projects.
 * A collaborative environment with opportunities for professional development.
 * Private medical subscription.
 Employment Details
 * Contract: Employment contract (CIM) only;
 * Duration: 2-year contract, with the possibility of extension.
 * Location: Bucharest, Theodor Pallady area. 
 * Work model: 100% on-site. 
 * Schedule: Full-time, with flexible working hours.
 If you are passionate about software development and interested in contributing to innovative AI and Cybersecurity projects, we would be happy to hear from you!
